res.summary:
I read all five SwiftUI files in mac/Sources/PaperInspector (App.swift 253 lines, RunView.swift 438, Engine.swift 194, Models.swift 217, BlinkView.swift 115), plus mac/build_app.sh, the generated Info.plist, engine/paperinspector/server.py (routes, jobs, settings) and the web SettingsDialog and RunView for a parity check. This was read-only: no file was edited.

The app works as a prototype, but it isn't yet a proper Mac app.

Structure: it's a two-column NavigationSplitView. Its detail pane holds a hand-built 3-pane HSplitView (RunView.swift:53-57) under a custom header bar of four push buttons (RunView.swift:63-92), where the toolbar and inspector should be. There is no `Settings` scene, so the AI investigator's provider and key can't be set from the Mac app at all. That is the biggest functional gap.

Menus: there is a single menu command, ⌘O. It replaces the File > New group, so New Window is gone, and it doesn't use focused values. There is no Find, Delete, Export, Inspector toggle, Print, Share or Quick Look. Nothing is persisted with @SceneStorage. Drag and drop only works on one dashed box and only reads `Data` payloads. Finder "Open With" and dropping on the Dock icon aren't supported (no CFBundleDocumentTypes, no `application(_:open:)`).

Colours are hard-coded RGB. Several pickers have empty labels. Figure panels can only be picked by mouse, so VoiceOver and keyboard users can't reach them.

Engine lifecycle is fragile:
- Engine output is sent to /dev/null.
- There is no termination handler or health monitor, so if the engine crashes the UI still shows it as ready.
- There is no version check, the port is fixed at 8765, and it is located through an absolute .venv path.
- After a 20 s start-up timeout the spinner stays forever with no Retry.
- Opening a second window can start a second engine.

Concrete Swift bugs:
- Strict Codable models: a missing key makes the whole report fail to open.
- Unchecked `box[2]`/`box[3]` indexing can crash.
- Divide-by-zero on a zero-sized figure.
- FigureCanvas keeps showing the stale image under new overlays.
- ManualCompare keeps showing an old error.
- AsyncImage spins forever when an image fails to load.
- Whole files are read into memory on the main actor for upload.
- Filenames containing quotes break the multipart upload.
- The open panel can't pick the xlsx/docx/zip supplements the UI says are supported.
- ⌘O ignores the "compare" toggle.
- After choosing a text-only finding, the user can no longer reach the figure browser.
- The sidebar score is not refreshed after an AI run.
- Polling tasks are never cancelled.
- The image cache never evicts anything.
- Deleting a scan asks for no confirmation.

Missing compared with the web app: "Show notes" for info findings, per-category counts, a figure strip with per-figure finding counts, measurement details (transform, rotation, scale) and case runs.

The redesign_spec gives a concrete target architecture for macOS 14+: three-column split view with `.inspector`, scene-level commands with keyboard shortcuts, a Settings scene, an engine state machine, file-based upload, Quick Look, share and export, state restoration, and an accessibility and dark-mode token system.

issues.problem: There is no Settings scene, so ⌘, does nothing. The AI investigator's provider, model, endpoint, API key, vision and effort settings, the OpenAlex key and the 'online' setting can't be configured from the Mac app. 'Ask the AI investigator' (RunView.swift:79) then just fails with a server error.
issues.change: Add `Settings { SettingsView().environment(engine) }` with tabs AI Investigator / Scholarly Data / Engine / General, backed by GET/POST /api/settings. Store keys only via the engine's POST, never in UserDefaults. Disable the AI button and show a 'Set up AI…' SettingsLink when key_set[provider] is false.

issues.problem: Every model uses synthesized, strict Codable. One missing or renamed key (for example `timings`, `panels`, `verdict`, `paper.pages`, `caption`, `confidence`, `evidence`, `counts`) makes JSONDecoder throw, and the whole scan won't open ('The data couldn't be read because it is missing'). Case runs and older reports are especially likely to hit this. Severity, kind and status are raw strings.
issues.change: Give non-identity fields default values through custom `init(from:)` with `decodeIfPresent ?? default`, or use a `@DefaultEmpty` property wrapper. Add `enum Severity: String, Codable, Comparable` (with `.unknown` fallback), `enum FindingKind`, `enum JobStatus`. Add `var case: [CaseMember]?` to Report and `var case: Bool?` to RunSummary. Add a unit test that decodes every report.json in tests/fixtures.

issues.problem: Engine lifecycle problems: (a) stdout/stderr go to /dev/null, so start-up failures can't be diagnosed. (b) There is no `terminationHandler` and no periodic health check, so if the engine crashes `ready` stays true and every call fails with 'Could not connect to the server'. (c) `start()` runs from each window's `.task`, so a second window, or a restored window, can spawn a second engine racing for port 8765. (d) After the 20 s timeout the detail pane keeps showing ProgressView next to the error text, with no Retry and no log access, and the spawned process is not terminated. (e) /api/health's `version` is ignored, so a stale engine from another checkout is silently reused. (f) The GUI-launched Process inherits launchd's minimal PATH (no /opt/homebrew/bin). (g) The fixed port 8765 conflicts with anything else on it.
issues.change: Replace `ready`/`status` with `enum EngineState { idle, locating, launching(attempt), ready(version), failed(EngineError), crashed(exitCode) }` in a single app-level `@Observable EngineController`. Start it once from `applicationDidFinishLaunching` and guard with `if case .launching = state { return }`. Pipe stdout/stderr to ~/Library/Logs/PaperInspector/engine.log through a FileHandle. Set `terminationHandler` → `.crashed` and auto-restart once. Poll /api/health every 10 s while ready. Compare versions and offer 'Restart engine'. Set `environment["PATH"]` to include /opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin. Use port 0 / `--port` from a free-port probe (or `PAPERINSPECTOR_PORT`) and keep the base URL in the controller. Show failures with ContentUnavailableView, offering Retry / Show Log / Choose Engine… buttons.

issues.problem: `Data(contentsOf:)` reads every file, which can be multi-GB supplementary zips, fully into memory on the @MainActor Engine, freezing the UI. The filename is interpolated unescaped into Content-Disposition, so a name containing `"` or CR/LF breaks the request. Folders dropped in throw an opaque error. When no PDF is present and compare is off, `files.first` (possibly an .xlsx) becomes the main `file`.
issues.change: Write the multipart body to a temp file off-main (`Task.detached` or a nonisolated helper streaming with FileHandle) and send it with `URLSession.upload(for:fromFile:)`. Track progress with `URLSessionTaskDelegate.didSendBodyData` and show it as an 'Uploading' stage. Percent-encode the filename (`filename*=UTF-8''…`) and strip quotes. Expand folders recursively. Pick the main file as first PDF, else first image, else reject with a clear message.

issues.problem: `p.box[2]`, `p.box[3]`, `b[0..3]` are indexed without a bounds check. A malformed box (fewer than 4 numbers) crashes the app with index out of range.
issues.change: Add `extension Array where Element == Double { var rect: CGRect? { count >= 4 ? CGRect(x: self[0], y: self[1], width: self[2], height: self[3]) : nil } }`. Use `compactMap` everywhere. Better still, decode `box` straight into a `CGRect` in PanelInfo/Loc.

issues.problem: `s = min(geo.size.width / figure.width, geo.size.height / figure.height)` divides by zero when the figure width or height is 0, or when the geometry is zero during layout. The NaN/inf frames then trigger 'Invalid frame dimension' and blank rendering.
issues.change: `guard figure.width > 0, figure.height > 0, geo.size.width > 0 else { return EmptyView() }` and clamp `s` to be finite.

issues.problem: `image` isn't reset when the URL changes, whether from a new figure or a new view mode. The old bitmap is drawn under the new figure's panel and mark overlays until the load finishes. If the load fails, the wrong figure stays forever with mismatched boxes.
issues.change: In the task do `image = nil; image = await Images.shared.load(url)`. Show a 'Could not load figure' state with Retry on nil. Better: keep the last image only when just the `mode` changed for the same figure id.

issues.problem: `.task(id: "\(a)|\(b)")` resets `result` but not `error`. After one failed comparison, every later pair shows the stale error instead of 'Aligning…'.
issues.change: Set `result = nil; error = nil` at the top of the task, and set `error` only on failure.

issues.problem: This `AsyncImage(url:content:placeholder:)` overload shows the placeholder on failure too, so a missing evidence PNG spins forever. The images also have no accessibility label and no Quick Look, copy or drag.
issues.change: Use the `AsyncImage(url:) { phase in }` overload with an explicit `.failure` view. Add `.accessibilityLabel("Evidence: \(e)")`, `.onTapGesture(count: 2) { quickLookURL = cachedFile }`, `.draggable(Image)` and a context menu (Copy Image, Quick Look, Save As…).

issues.problem: Choosing a finding with no figure sets `figureID = nil`. The figure Menu only exists when a figure is shown (line 180), so the user loses all access to figures until they pick an image finding. Text findings also leave the centre pane as a dead 'about the text' label.
issues.change: Keep the last figure when the finding has no figure. Put the figure picker in the toolbar or a persistent figure strip (thumbnails with per-figure finding counts, like web RunView.tsx:196), always visible. For text, stat or reference findings, render the quote/page context, or the relevant PDF page from /api/runs/{id}/source via PDFKit, in the centre pane.

issues.problem: NSOpenPanel `allowedContentTypes = [.pdf, .png, .jpeg, .tiff]`, but the drop zone copy (App.swift:178) says spreadsheets, Word files, images and zips are checked. ⌘O can't select supplements. `runModal()` is also called synchronously inside `.onReceive`, which blocks and isn't window-attached.
issues.change: Replace with SwiftUI `.fileImporter(isPresented:allowedContentTypes:[.pdf,.image,.spreadsheet,.commaSeparatedText,.zip,UTType(filenameExtension:"docx")!,UTType(filenameExtension:"xlsx")!,.plainText], allowsMultipleSelection: true)` attached to the window, so it shows as a sheet. Show the panel's message: 'Choose the paper PDF and any supplementary files'.

issues.problem: The `compare` toggle is private HomeView @State. ⌘O → `ContentView.start` always calls `engine.scan(urls)` with compare=false, so several PDFs picked through the menu are never treated as a case. ⌘O also isn't disabled while a job runs, so two jobs overwrite the shared `job` binding.
issues.change: Move the job queue into an app-level `@Observable ScanQueue` (array of `ScanJob { id, title, stage, progress, status, cancel }`). Show an import options sheet after file selection (radio: 'One paper with supplements' / 'Separate papers: compare images'), or infer it and confirm. Allow concurrent jobs, listed in a sidebar 'In progress' section.

issues.problem: Only `Data` payloads from `loadItem(forTypeIdentifier:)` are handled. A provider that yields `URL`/`NSURL` is silently dropped. Dropping only works on the dashed box, not on the window, sidebar or Dock icon. No file-type validation is done. The drop returns true even when nothing usable was found.
issues.change: Use `.dropDestination(for: URL.self) { urls, _ in queue.add(urls); return !urls.isEmpty } isTargeted: { dropping = $0 }` on the whole NavigationSplitView, with a full-window overlay highlight. Add `CFBundleDocumentTypes` (PDF, images, xlsx, docx, zip; LSHandlerRank Alternate) in build_app.sh and implement `AppDelegate.application(_:open:)` for Dock drops and Finder 'Open With'. Handle `paperinspector://doi/...` URLs via `onOpenURL`.

issues.problem: The run screen nests a custom HSplitView with three fixed minimum widths (260 + 380 + 340 = 980) inside a split-view detail. With the 260 sidebar this exceeds the 1100 window minimum (App.swift:14), so panes clip. The header recreates a toolbar from push buttons ('Paper', 'Draft comment', 'Open report', AI). There is no `.navigationTitle`/`.navigationSubtitle`. The AI button's label morphs into the job stage, so its width jumps. `aiError` is drawn as an overlay over the header's bottom edge.
issues.change: Use a three-column `NavigationSplitView(sidebar:content:detail:)`: runs | findings | figure stage. Add `.inspector(isPresented:)` for finding detail (macOS 14). Move the actions into `.toolbar`, set `.navigationTitle(paper title)` and `.navigationSubtitle(journal · year · doi)`. Show AI progress as a toolbar ProgressView with Cancel, and errors as `.alert` or an inline banner with Retry.

issues.problem: There is only one menu command, and replacing `.newItem` removes New Window. Commands are broadcast through NotificationCenter, so every open window responds and each one opens a panel. There are no shortcuts for Find, Delete, next/previous finding, toggling the inspector or sidebar, export, share, print, re-run, revealing in Finder, copying the DOI, or Blink. SidebarCommands and InspectorCommands aren't included.
issues.change: Use `@FocusedValue(\.runActions)` / `.focusedSceneValue` instead of NotificationCenter. Add a CommandGroup set as listed in the spec's Commands table: ⌘N New Scan, ⌘O Open Files…, ⇧⌘D Inspect DOI…, ⌘⌫ Move to Trash, ⌘F Find, ⇧⌘E Export, ⌘P Print, ⌥⌘I Inspector, etc. Include `SidebarCommands()`, `InspectorCommands()`, `ToolbarCommands()`, `TextEditingCommands()`.

issues.problem: No state restoration. The selected run, finding, figure, view mode, category filter and inspector visibility are plain @State and lost on relaunch or window reopen. The window frame isn't restored either: WindowGroup restores it, but the selection isn't kept.
issues.change: Use `@SceneStorage("selectedRun")`, `@SceneStorage("run.<id>.finding")` (or a Codable `RunViewState` serialized as JSON per run), `@SceneStorage("viewMode")`, `@SceneStorage("categoryFilter")` and `@SceneStorage("inspectorShown")`. Use `@AppStorage` for global prefs such as blink interval, show-notes and sort order.

issues.problem: Delete Scan runs immediately with no confirmation and no undo, and errors are swallowed (`try?`). The Delete key doesn't work in the sidebar, and multi-select delete isn't possible.
issues.change: Use `.confirmationDialog("Delete “\(title)”?", …)` with role .destructive. Better: move the run folder to the Trash through `NSWorkspace.recycle` or a server-side soft delete, and register undo with `UndoManager`. Support `List(selection: Set<String>)`, `.onDeleteCommand` and `.contextMenu(forSelectionType:)`. Surface failures.

issues.problem: Colours are hard-coded sRGB literals (score badge, severity, Retracted badge) and fixed greys (white 0.16/0.15), with `.cyan` used for drop targeting. They don't adapt to dark mode, Increase Contrast or the user's accent colour. `.secondary` for 'low' is invisible as a 3 pt bar. Severity relies mainly on colour.
issues.change: Define a `Theme` with `NSColor(name:dynamicProvider:)` tokens (severity.critical/high/medium/low/info, score bands, stage.background, mark.a / mark.b), checking `accessibilityDisplayShouldIncreaseContrast`. Use `.tint`/`Color.accentColor` for focus and drop states. Pair every severity colour with an SF Symbol (exclamationmark.octagon.fill / exclamationmark.triangle.fill / exclamationmark.circle / info.circle).

issues.problem: Accessibility gaps: figure panels are bare Rectangles with onTapGesture plus `.help`, so VoiceOver and keyboard users can't reach or select them. The segmented Pickers use `""` labels with `labelsHidden()`, so VoiceOver announces nothing. Swipe mode is drag-only. ScoreBadge reads as a bare number. The marks use cyan/pink with no pattern.
issues.change: Panels: `.accessibilityElement()`, `.accessibilityLabel("Panel \(p.id), \(p.kind)")`, `.accessibilityAddTraits(isPicked ? [.isButton, .isSelected] : .isButton)`, `.accessibilityAction { onPanel(p.id) }`, plus `.focusable()` and `.onKeyPress(.space)`. Give pickers real labels ('View mode', 'Comparison mode'). Swipe: `.accessibilityRepresentation { Slider(value:$split) }` and ←/→ via onKeyPress. ScoreBadge: `.accessibilityLabel("Integrity score \(score) of 100, \(band)")`. Marks: dashed vs solid strokes as well as colour.

issues.problem: `.keyboardShortcut(.space, modifiers: [])` on 'Flip once' registers Space window-wide whenever BlinkView is visible. It steals Space from List type-ahead, from Quick Look (which needs Space) and from focused buttons.
issues.change: Make the stage `.focusable()` and use `.onKeyPress(.space)` only when the stage has focus. Map ←/→ to A/B and 1/2/3/4 to modes. Keep Space free for Quick Look on selected evidence or files.

issues.problem: Engine is `@MainActor`, so JSON decoding and multipart building run on the main thread. `wait()` polls in unstructured `Task {}` blocks that are never cancelled. After the engine restarts (in-memory JOBS, server.py:30), polling fails with 'no such job'. `refresh()` swallows errors.
issues.change: Make `EngineClient` an `actor` (or a nonisolated Sendable struct) with async methods, publishing state to a @MainActor @Observable store. Keep polling Task handles in ScanQueue and cancel them on Cancel or quit, and handle 404 as 'Engine restarted; the scan was lost — Retry'. Surface refresh errors in the sidebar footer ('Engine offline — Reconnect').

issues.problem: The image cache is an unbounded `[URL: NSImage]` that is never evicted: 5 view modes × every figure × every run opened, plus blink frames. It grows without limit. Concurrent loads of the same URL are duplicated and failures are never retried.
issues.change: Use `NSCache<NSURL, NSImage>` with `totalCostLimit` around 300 MB (cost = width × height × 4). Dedupe in-flight loads with `[URL: Task<NSImage?, Never>]`. Purge a run's entries on delete.

issues.problem: After the AI investigation finishes, the report reloads but `engine.refresh()` isn't called, so the sidebar badge keeps the old score while the header shows `score_ai`. The sidebar always shows `score`, never `score_ai`. The job can't be cancelled.
issues.change: Call `await engine.refresh()` after it finishes. Show `score_ai ?? score` in the sidebar with a small 'AI' marker. Add Cancel, which needs a DELETE /api/jobs/{id} endpoint or at least stops polling.

issues.problem: Info-severity findings (report.timeline, record notes and so on) are filtered out entirely, with no way to show them. The web app has a 'Show N notes' toggle (web/src/RunView.tsx:175-176). Category chips show no counts. The list has no search and no sort.
issues.change: Add a 'Show notes' toggle in the findings column's filter bar, persisted with @AppStorage. Show a count per category (`Images 4`). Add `.searchable(text:placement:.toolbar)` filtering on title, detail and check name, and a sort menu (Severity, Confidence, Figure order).

issues.problem: Supplement and source links and 'Open report' open http://127.0.0.1:… in the default web browser, which then downloads the file. There is no Quick Look, no 'Open in Excel/Numbers', no Save As, no drag-out, and no export of report HTML/PDF/JSON from the app.
issues.change: Add a `FileFetcher` that downloads to ~/Library/Caches/PaperInspector/<run>/<name> and then offers: Quick Look (`.quickLookPreview($url, in: urls)`), Open With Default App (`NSWorkspace.open`), Reveal in Finder, and Save As via `.fileExporter`. Export menu: Report (HTML), Report (PDF, rendered with WKWebView.createPDF), Findings (CSV/JSON), Draft comment (TXT). Share via `ShareLink(item: reportFileURL)`.

issues.problem: `engine.pubpeer` returns "" on any error, so the sheet shows an empty editor with no loading or error state. 'Copy draft' gives no feedback. There's no Share or Save option, and edits are lost when the sheet closes.
issues.change: Show an explicit loading state (ProgressView) and an error state with Retry. Show 'Copied' feedback with a `checkmark` symbol swap for 1.5 s. Add a ShareLink(item: text), Save As… (.fileExporter, .txt/.md), and persist edits per run in Application Support/drafts/<run>.md.

issues.problem: The home screen reads like a web landing page rather than a Mac app: a 42 pt serif headline, two equally prominent buttons (Inspect and the demo button both use borderedProminent), and a drop zone that isn't the window. The job shows inline without Cancel. Recent DOIs aren't remembered, and there's no 'Paste DOI from clipboard' detection. The DOI trim uses `.whitespaces`, so pasted newlines are kept.
issues.change: Use a ContentUnavailableView-style empty state: app icon, title 'Inspect a Paper', a DOI field with `.textFieldStyle(.roundedBorder)` + a primary 'Inspect' button (⌘↩), secondary 'Open Files…' and 'Try Demo' as `.bordered`/`.link` buttons, and a privacy footnote. Auto-fill the DOI field when the pasteboard contains a DOI (`NSPasteboard` detect pattern `10\.\d{4,9}/\S+`). Trim with `.whitespacesAndNewlines`. Keep 10 recent DOIs in @AppStorage as a menu on the field.

issues.problem: The sidebar has no empty state, no search, no grouping by date, and no 'In progress' section. `created` is never shown and case runs aren't marked. Titles are serif with two lines. The toolbar's 'New scan' just deselects.
issues.change: Group sections Today / This Week / Earlier, plus an 'In Progress' section with live ProgressView rows. Show the relative date (`Text(date, style: .relative)` or `.formatted(.relative)`). Add a `person.2` symbol for cases, `.searchable` in the sidebar placement, ContentUnavailableView('No Scans Yet') when empty, and a footer showing engine status (green dot 'Engine 0.x ready' / red 'Offline – Restart').

issues.problem: `.task(id: a)` reloads only when `a` changes. A change of `b` or `diff` with the same `a` isn't picked up, and images load one after another. `playing = !reduceMotion` is reset each reload, overriding the user's Pause.
issues.change: Use `.task(id: [a, b, diff])` with `async let` parallel loads. Keep `playing` in @AppStorage('blinkAutoplay'), and AND it with `!reduceMotion` at render time.

issues.problem: The app is tied to the developer's machine: the engine path is the absolute dev .venv baked into Info.plist. There are no CFBundleDocumentTypes or URL scheme, no LSApplicationCategoryType, the version is hard-coded at 0.1.0, codesign is ad hoc only, and `swift run` (no bundle) falls back to only three hard-coded paths.
issues.change: Add LSApplicationCategoryType=public.app-category.productivity, CFBundleDocumentTypes, CFBundleURLTypes(paperinspector), and a version derived from `paperinspector --version`. Add a 'Choose Engine…' button in Settings > Engine that stores a security-scoped bookmark/path in @AppStorage, and search `<app>/../../.venv/bin` and the result of `which paperinspector` (run via a login shell) as fallbacks.

issues.problem: `NSApp.activate(ignoringOtherApps:)` is deprecated on macOS 14. The app quits when the last window closes even while a scan is running, which kills the engine mid-job without warning.
issues.change: Use `NSApp.activate()`. Implement `applicationShouldTerminate` to return `.terminateLater` with an alert when the ScanQueue has running jobs ('A scan is still running. Quit anyway?'). Consider returning false from applicationShouldTerminateAfterLastWindowClosed so finished-scan notifications can still arrive.

issues.problem: `checkNames`, `severityOrder` and `categoryNames` are hand-copied from the engine and web (web/src/api.ts:250-262). They will drift, and unknown checks show raw ids such as 'image.foo'.
issues.change: Serve a `/api/catalog` (checks → name/description/category/kind, severities, categories) from the engine and cache it in the Mac app, with the static table kept only as a fallback.

issues.problem: The finding inspector lacks the structured measurements the web app shows (transform: mirrored, rotation, scale; inliers; NCC from `finding.data`, see web/src/RunView.tsx:320-330). It has no Copy finding, no Reveal on page, and no buttons to mark a finding Confirmed or Dismissed for reviewer triage.
issues.change: Add a 'Measurements' `Grid`/`LabeledContent` section rendered from `f.data`. Add a footer action bar: Copy as Text (⌘C), Copy Evidence Image, Show on Page (opens the PDF page in a PDFKit sheet at `loc.page` with a highlight), and Triage segmented control (Unreviewed / Confirmed / Dismissed) persisted per run in Application Support/triage.json, shown as row badges and as a list filter.

issues.problem: No notifications or Dock feedback when a long DOI scan finishes in the background. No Help menu content. No About panel credits. No 'Check engine' diagnostics.
issues.change: Send a UNUserNotificationCenter notification on job completion when the app is inactive (click opens the run). Show `NSApp.dockTile.badgeLabel` with the number of running jobs. Add Help > 'How the Checks Work' (opens the bundled docs page) and 'Show Engine Log'. Set About panel credits through `.commands { CommandGroup(replacing: .appInfo) }` with `NSApp.orderFrontStandardAboutPanel(options:)`.

res.redesign_spec:
REDESIGN SPEC: Paper Inspector for Mac (SwiftUI, macOS 14+, Swift 5.10, SPM)

0. GOALS
Make it feel like Preview crossed with Xcode's issue navigator: a native three-column window, a real toolbar, an inspector, full menus and keyboard control, Quick Look, Share and Export, a Settings window, a robust engine lifecycle, accessibility, and adaptive colour. Keep the existing engine HTTP API and add only small endpoints (noted with NEW).

1. FILE LAYOUT (mac/Sources/PaperInspector/)
- App/PaperInspectorApp.swift: scenes and commands
- App/AppDelegate.swift: open-files, terminate guard, notifications, dock badge
- App/Commands.swift: CommandGroups plus FocusedValues keys
- Engine/EngineController.swift: @MainActor @Observable state machine; owns the Process
- Engine/EngineClient.swift: `actor`; typed API calls, upload from file, polling
- Engine/ScanQueue.swift: @MainActor @Observable; running/finished jobs, cancel
- Engine/ImageStore.swift: NSCache + in-flight dedupe
- Engine/FileFetcher.swift: download supplements/source/report to Caches for Quick Look/Open/Save
- Model/Models.swift: lenient Codable (decodeIfPresent defaults), Severity/Kind/JobStatus enums, CGRect boxes
- Model/Catalog.swift: check names from /api/catalog (NEW), with a static fallback
- Model/Triage.swift: per-run reviewer triage store (Application Support/PaperInspector/triage/<run>.json)
- UI/Theme.swift: dynamic colour tokens and severity symbols
- UI/Sidebar/RunsSidebar.swift, RunRow.swift, InProgressRow.swift, EngineStatusFooter.swift
- UI/Home/HomeView.swift (empty and start state), ImportOptionsSheet.swift
- UI/Run/RunSplit.swift (content plus detail plus inspector wiring), FindingsColumn.swift, FindingRow.swift, FigureStage.swift, FigureCanvas.swift, FigureStrip.swift, TextContextView.swift (PDFKit page with highlight), FindingInspector.swift, MeasurementsSection.swift, ManualCompareInspector.swift, BlinkView.swift
- UI/Sheets/DraftCommentSheet.swift, PaperInfoSheet.swift (becomes an inspector tab)
- UI/Settings/SettingsView.swift (tabs), AISettingsTab.swift, DataSettingsTab.swift, EngineSettingsTab.swift, GeneralSettingsTab.swift
- UI/Common/ScoreBadge.swift, SeverityLabel.swift, ErrorBanner.swift, QuickLookSupport.swift

2. SCENES
```swift
@main struct PaperInspectorApp: App {
  @NSApplicationDelegateAdaptor(AppDelegate.self) var delegate
  @State var engine = EngineController.shared      // started in applicationDidFinishLaunching, once
  @State var queue  = ScanQueue.shared
  var body: some Scene {
    WindowGroup("Paper Inspector", id: "main") { MainWindow().environment(engine).environment(queue) }
      .defaultSize(width: 1440, height: 900)
      .commands { AppCommands() }                    // see section 6
    Window("Blink Comparator", id: "blink") { BlinkWindow() }   // detachable comparator (⌥⌘B)
      .defaultSize(width: 900, height: 700)
    Window("Engine Log", id: "log") { EngineLogView() }
    Settings { SettingsView().environment(engine) }
  }
}
```
MainWindow minimum frame is 900x600. Remove the hard 1100x700 minimum.

3. WINDOW STRUCTURE (MainWindow)
`NavigationSplitView(columnVisibility: $columns) { RunsSidebar } content: { FindingsColumn } detail: { FigureStage }`, with `.inspector(isPresented: $inspectorShown) { FindingInspector }` (width min 300, ideal 360, max 520).
- Column widths: sidebar min 200, ideal 240, max 320. Content (findings) min 280, ideal 320, max 420. The detail column takes the rest.
- When no run is selected, the content and detail columns are replaced by HomeView: `columnVisibility = .doubleColumn`, so HomeView fills the detail area.
- `.navigationTitle(report.displayTitle)`. `.navigationSubtitle("\(journal) · \(year) · doi:\(doi)")`.
- A drop target covers the whole window: `.dropDestination(for: URL.self) { urls, _ in queue.importFiles(urls) } isTargeted: { dropTargeted = $0 }`. While targeted, show an overlay: a RoundedRectangle stroked with accentColor, a material background and the text 'Drop a paper PDF and its supplementary files'.

3a. SIDEBAR (RunsSidebar)
- `List(selection: $selectedRuns: Set<RunSummary.ID>)`.

11. ENGINE LIFECYCLE (EngineController, @MainActor @Observable)
- State: `.idle, .locating, .launching(attempt:Int), .ready(version:String, port:Int), .failed(EngineError), .crashed(code:Int32)`.
- EngineError cases: notFound(searched:[String]), launchFailed(String), timeout(seconds:Int), versionMismatch(found:String, expected:String), portBusy(Int).
- `start()` is idempotent (it returns early unless the state is idle, failed or crashed). It is called once from applicationDidFinishLaunching, not from a view's `.task`.
- Locate the engine in this order: @AppStorage override, env PAPERINSPECTOR_ENGINE, Info.plist PaperInspectorEngine, <bundle>/../../.venv/bin/paperinspector, ~/.local/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin, then `/bin/zsh -lc 'command -v paperinspector'`.
- Port: if a healthy engine already answers on the stored port with a matching version, reuse it. Otherwise pick a free port (bind a socket to 0, read the port, close it) and pass `serve --port N`. EngineClient.base derives from the controller.
- Process setup: environment = ProcessInfo env, with PATH prefixed by /opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin and PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1. stdout and stderr go to a Pipe whose readabilityHandler appends to ~/Library/Logs/PaperInspector/engine.log and to an in-memory ring buffer (last 2000 lines) shown in the 'log' window. `terminationHandler` hops to the main actor and sets `.crashed(code)` unless `stopping`.
- Health: wait with exponential backoff (250 ms up to 2 s), with a total timeout of 60 s on first launch and 20 s afterwards. On timeout, terminate the child and set `.failed(.timeout)`. While ready, ping /api/health every 15 s. Two consecutive failures → `.crashed`, then one automatic restart, then show the banner.
- UI mapping:
  - launching → the sidebar footer spinner, and HomeView shows 'Starting the analysis engine…' with determinate attempts;
  - failed or crashed → ContentUnavailableView(systemImage: "exclamationmark.triangle") with the message and buttons Retry, Show Log, Choose Engine…, Open Settings.
  Previously finished runs stay browsable only if the engine is reachable; otherwise show the cached list greyed out.
- Quit: `applicationShouldTerminate` → if queue.hasRunning, NSAlert 'A scan is still running' (Quit Anyway / Cancel). Then terminate the child: SIGTERM, wait up to 2 s, then SIGKILL. Do this only if this app launched the engine.

12. NETWORKING / CONCURRENCY
- EngineClient is an `actor` with a URLSession configured with timeoutIntervalForRequest 30 and timeoutIntervalForResource 3600 for uploads. A shared JSONDecoder with lenient models.
- Upload: build the multipart body into a temp file on the actor by streaming each input file with FileHandle in 1 MB chunks. Use `Content-Disposition: form-data; name="…"; filename="<ascii-safe>"; filename*=UTF-8''<pct-encoded>` and a guessed Content-Type from UTType. Send with `session.upload(for:fromFile:delegate:)` and report progress to ScanQueue as stage 'Uploading' (0-0.1 of the bar).
- Polling: `for await job in client.poll(jobID, every: .milliseconds(400))` as an AsyncThrowingStream. The Task handle is stored in ScanQueue.jobs[id].task. Cancel cancels the task and calls the NEW endpoint DELETE /api/jobs/{id}. A 404 maps to `.engineRestarted` with a Retry action that re-submits the same inputs (kept in the job record).
- ScanQueue on completion: refresh runs; if the app is inactive, post a UNUserNotification ('Scan finished: <title> – score N'); update `NSApp.dockTile.badgeLabel` with the running count; auto-select the new run only if the user hasn't selected something else since starting it.
- ImageStore: `NSCache<NSURL, NSImage>` (totalCostLimit 300 MB), inFlight `[URL: Task<NSImage?, Error>]`, `purge(run:)`.

13. MODELS
- Every field except ids decodes with defaults:
  - Report: timings `[:]`, panels 0, verdict "", figures `[]`, findings `[]`;
  - PaperInfo: doi "", pages 0;
  - FigureInfo: caption "", width and height 0, panels `[]`;
  - Finding: confidence 0, evidence `[]`, locations `[]`, kind `.integrity`;
  - RunSummary: counts `[:]`, case false.
- Add `Report.case: [CaseMember]?` and `Report.counts: [String:Int]?`.
- Box decoding: `[Double]` → `CGRect?` (nil unless count ≥ 4 and all finite).
- `enum Severity: String, Codable, CaseIterable, Comparable { critical, high, medium, low, info, unknown }`, with an `init(from:)` fallback to .unknown and `var symbol`, `var color`, `var label`.
- `enum JobStatus { running, done, error, cancelled, unknown }`.
- Use `Date` for `created` via an ISO8601 strategy, with a fallback that keeps the String.
- Catalog: fetched once from NEW GET /api/catalog `{checks:{id:{name,category,kind,description}}, categories:[...], severities:[...]}`; the static table is the fallback.

14. THEME / DARK MODE / ACCESSIBILITY
- `extension Color { static func dynamic(light: NSColor, dark: NSColor) -> Color { Color(nsColor: NSColor(name: nil) { $0.bestMatch(from: [.darkAqua, .vibrantDark, .accessibilityHighContrastDarkAqua]) != nil ? dark : light }) } }`.
- Tokens:
  - severity.critical (light #B3261E / dark #FF6B5E)
  - severity.high (#C2410C / #FF8A4C)
  - severity.medium (#A16207 / #F5B544)
  - severity.low (systemGray / systemGray)
  - severity.info (secondaryLabelColor)
  - score bands (same as severity)
  - mark.a (#00B8D9), mark.b (#E0447C), stage.background
  Add Increase Contrast variants with darker light / lighter dark values.
- Never encode meaning in colour alone. Severity symbols: critical `exclamationmark.octagon.fill`, high `exclamationmark.triangle.fill`, medium `exclamationmark.circle.fill`, low `circle.fill` (small), info `info.circle`.
- Typography: system font for UI chrome. Serif (`.serif` design) only for quoted paper text and captions. Dynamic font sizes via text styles; no fixed point sizes.
- Accessibility:
  - every icon-only button has a `Label` with title plus `.labelStyle(.iconOnly)`;
  - all Pickers have real titles;
  - ScoreBadge has `.accessibilityLabel("Integrity score \(n) of 100, \(band)")`;
  - FigureCanvas panels are accessibility elements with actions;
  - BlinkView swipe uses an `accessibilityRepresentation` Slider;
  - respect Reduce Motion (no autoplay blink and no animated transitions) and Reduce Transparency (opaque materials);
  - VoiceOver rotor: `.accessibilityRotor("Integrity signals")` over findings.
  Test with Accessibility Inspector, and keep a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 on the ScoreBadge text.

15. ERROR HANDLING
- A single `AppError: LocalizedError` with title, message, recoverySuggestion, and a recovery `[RecoveryAction]` (retry, showLog, openSettings, chooseEngine).
- Map URLError.cannotConnectToHost → 'The analysis engine isn't running' + Restart. Map HTTP 4xx `detail` → the message as-is. Map 5xx → 'The engine hit an error' + Show Log. Map DecodingError → 'This scan was saved by a different engine version' + Re-run Scan.
- Present errors with `.alert(isPresented:error:actions:message:)` for blocking failures, and ErrorBanner for inline ones (AI job, figure load). Never use silent `try?` for user-initiated actions: delete, pubpeer, refresh on demand.
